product.name: Home Assistant Green
product.version: illustrative example v0.1, 8 Nov 2026, template v0.39

PC.title: Home Assistant Operating System (Home Assistant Core and Supervisor)

SP.title: No default account
SP.desc: The owner account and password are created during onboarding; there is no default password.

SP.title: No onboard radios
SP.desc: The device has no Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Zigbee or Thread radio; radio interfaces exist only if the user adds adapters.

SP.title: Backup before update
SP.desc: Updates offer an automatic or manual backup before they are installed.

SP.title: Factory reset clears the data partition
SP.desc: The reset removes all user data as well as Home Assistant Core, the Supervisor and installed apps.

CC.title: Home router and network
CC.desc: The wired network the device connects to by Ethernet.

CC.title: Smart home devices
CC.desc: Devices controlled through integrations or USB radio adapters.

CC.title: USB radio adapters
CC.desc: For example Home Assistant Connect ZBT-1 (Zigbee or Thread) or ZWA-2 (Z-Wave).

CC.title: Administration device
CC.desc: A browser or phone used to open the web interface.

CC.title: Update servers
CC.desc: Servers delivering Home Assistant versions during onboarding and updates.

CC.title: Off-device backup location
CC.desc: Home Assistant Cloud or another location outside the device.

CC.title: Monitor and keyboard
CC.desc: Used for the local console during recovery.

CP.title: Owner
CP.desc: The person who sets up the hub and holds the owner account.

CP.title: Household users
CP.desc: People with their own Home Assistant accounts.

CZ.title: Physical location
CZ.desc: Where the hub is installed (indoors, 0 to 40 C)

CU.title: Strong passwords, trusted users only
CU.desc: Use a strong owner password and create accounts only for people you trust fully: Home Assistant assumes every user is trusted.

CU.title: Wired, local, not exposed
CU.desc: Connect by Ethernet to a network you control and do not expose the web interface (port 8123) directly to the internet.

CU.title: Trusted integrations and apps only
CU.desc: Install only integrations, apps and plugins from sources you trust; malicious third-party additions are outside Home Assistant's security scope.

CU.title: Known adapters
CU.desc: Use radio adapters from known sources.

CU.title: Backups off the device
CU.desc: Store backups outside the device, for example in Home Assistant Cloud or another location.

CU.title: Control physical access
CU.desc: Anyone with a monitor and keyboard can reset the owner password from the console. Keep the hub where only trusted people can reach it.

CU.title: Install updates and check afterwards
CU.desc: Install Home Assistant OS updates when offered, then check Settings > System > Repairs and Logs.

CU.title: Internet during reset
CU.desc: Make sure the hub has a working internet connection before a factory reset; otherwise the reset fails.

FC.title: Run the smart home
FC.desc: Run Home Assistant integrations and automations for connected devices.

FC.title: Administer Home Assistant
FC.desc: Configure the system and accounts in the web interface.
FC.rfu: Giving accounts to people who should not have full trust.

FC.title: Back up and restore
FC.desc: Create backups and restore or migrate from them.

FC.title: Recover access
FC.desc: Reset the owner password from the local console with an HDMI monitor and USB keyboard.

FC.title: Install security updates
FC.desc: Install Home Assistant OS updates from Settings, or ha os update on the command line.

FC.title: Factory reset
FC.desc: Clear the data partition and reinstall (HA OS 13.1 or later, or with an SD card).

RI.title: Untrusted account holder
RI.desc: An account is given to someone who should not have full control.
RI.damage: Any logged-in user can change the system; privilege escalation by users is out of scope.

RI.title: Web interface exposed to the internet
RI.desc: Port 8123 is forwarded from the internet.
RI.damage: Attackers can attempt to log in or exploit the interface.

RI.title: Malicious integration
RI.desc: A third-party integration, app or plugin is installed from an untrusted source.
RI.damage: The smart home and its data are controlled by the attacker.

RI.title: No off-device backup
RI.desc: Backups are kept only on the hub.
RI.damage: A failed update, reset or device loss destroys the configuration.

RI.title: Unattended physical access
RI.desc: Untrusted people can reach the hub.
RI.damage: The owner password can be reset and the system taken over.

RI.title: Reset without internet
RI.desc: A factory reset is started without internet.
RI.damage: The reset fails and leaves the device unusable until recovered.
